description:
Twenty-two-year-old Beta Yoon Ha-Seong struggles as the bassist for an unknown indie band. After a failed performance and being dumped by his girlfriend, he's left in tears when he runs into famous actor Go Ye-Han. Ye-Han, claiming to be his fan, offers him a job and connects him with a famous composer to learn composition. Ha-Seong actively supports him and treats him with affection. Despite feeling a sense of unease, he finds himself drawn to Ye-Han. To repay the favor, he helps Ha-Seong with his rut, which involves managing his pheromones.

"Huh, Ma-an... I'm not even an omega," he says. " Ha-Seong, you're overflowing with talent. You'd be better off with me than most omegas."

What started as a simple attempt to help him somehow leads to a rut partner. And perhaps he shouldn't have ignored the initial sense of unease.

 *"It's true I wanted to have sex with you. But... is that really that problematic?"*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
